name: tsba-ai-agent
description: TSBA Technical Support assistant — password-protected preview (Ask + Progress). React + Node + Postgres/pgvector + pg-boss.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tsba/backend && npm run build -w @tsba/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tsba/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tsba/backend && npm run typecheck -w @tsba/frontend
